case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for explaining the cost components behind it. We recognise the pressure from rising alloy, processing and labour costs; our counterproposal rests on our commercial analysis, not an assumption that those costs have fallen.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

The longer agreement offers continuity for the account in exchange for a lower price. We are flexible on payment terms, including retaining your quoted term in Option B; please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our relationship and welcome a transparent discussion of the calculation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We appreciate the proposal for a 24-month agreement, which offers valuable continuity for both of us.
For a contract of this length, we cannot offer a fixed price and must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility.
With this index clause and your preferred 30-day payment term, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for reducing your price and confirming the material share; we recognise your need for alloy-cost protection and respect your limit on further cost disclosure. We are making a modest price move in return and ask you to reciprocate.

Each option includes the alloy index clause you requested alongside the longer agreement, with Option C offering adjustment without a deadband in exchange for the lowest base price. We are flexible on the deadband; which package works best for your approval process?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.38 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.34 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.27 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive engagement and hope this gives you a clear proposal to take forward internally.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

The package without a deadband works best for us, and in response to your move, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit for it. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We have made a substantial step toward your position and ask you to close the remaining gap. 

Accordingly, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership and finalizing this agreement with you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
